headline_findings.claim: Ripple Prime clients have access to the full suite of Coinbase Derivatives contracts cleared by Nodal Clear, including institutional and nano XRP contracts.
headline_findings.mechanism: Ripple Prime/Hidden Road FCM access; Coinbase Derivatives is the CFTC-registered DCM; Nodal Clear is the CFTC-registered DCO.
limits: Access announcement does not establish actual client positions, XRP open interest attributable to Ripple Prime, or spot XRP purchases.
The joint announcement is one coordinated first-party release, not independent corroboration.

headline_findings.claim: Coinbase Global Exchange lists XRP as eligible cross-collateral for perpetual-futures portfolios.
headline_findings.mechanism: Asset quantity is capped by an organization-level average-daily-quantity limit. Collateral weight reflects the greater of the static base haircut and size-sensitive closeout-horizon haircut. Collateral may be automatically liquidated when maintenance-margin coverage fails.
limits: Current XRP-specific base haircut, closeout haircut and ADQ cap were not retrieved.
This is Global Exchange cross-collateral, not the Coinbase consumer Morpho loan or Coinbase Bermuda Global Derivatives regime.

headline_findings.claim: Coinbase Global Exchange USDC Borrow accrues interest at 10% APY, holds non-USDC collateral on-platform, and uses asset-specific collateral multipliers and borrow limits exposed through API fields.
limits: Current XRP loan_collateral_requirement_multiplier, min_borrow_qty, max_borrow_qty and aggregate XRP balances were not retrieved.
Insufficient collateral can lead to collateral liquidation or rolling debt; this is separate from perpetual-futures margin.

headline_findings.claim: Coinbase's consumer crypto-backed loan product supports XRP as collateral for up to 100,000 USDC for eligible U.S. users outside New York, through a Morpho integration on Base.
limits: Coinbase confirms asset eligibility and the 100,000 USDC cap. The Block reports up to 49% LTV and liquidation at 62.5% for XRP/DOGE/ADA/LTC.
Do not apply Coinbase's generic 86% BTC/ETH liquidation figure to XRP.

The exact consumer-loan routing from XRP to the cbXRP/USDC Morpho market is strongly suggested by the matching asset and 62.5% LLTV, but the exact per-loan wrapper route was not independently traced in this run.

headline_findings.claim: Coinbase Q3 2026 reported average USDC held in Coinbase products of 22 billion dollars, up 49% year over year and an all-time high for the fourteenth consecutive quarter. Coinbase said it captured approximately 50% of USDC economics over the prior year.
limits: Metrics are company-reported; prediction-market annualized revenue is not a quarterly GAAP revenue figure.
USDC balances are not XRP balances or proof of XRP buying.

headline_findings.claim: Coinbase Q3 2026 stablecoin revenue was 306.905 million dollars, versus 324.534 million dollars in Q3 2025; nine-month stablecoin revenue was 904.487 million dollars versus 907.485 million dollars.
limits: Coinbase's stablecoin revenue line is not identical to Circle's distribution-cost line or a direct measure of USDC transfer volume.

headline_findings.claim: Circle's Q2 2026 filing reports 324.6 million dollars of distribution costs paid in connection with Coinbase agreements in Q2 and 655.3 million dollars in H1.
limits: These are Circle expenses under its distribution arrangements, not an additional amount to add to Coinbase stablecoin revenue.

The Circle filing's 12.442 billion dollars of USDC on platform and 19.5% daily weighted-average share refer to Circle's own platform, not Coinbase's platform. The filing defines the metric as USDC held on Circle's platform.

headline_findings.claim: Coinbase's Q3 filing says its Circle arrangement was renewed on the same terms. Coinbase's own Q3 release separately reports 22 billion dollars average USDC held in Coinbase products.
headline_findings.correction: A prior handoff misattributed Circle's Q2 'USDC on platform' 12.442 billion dollars and 19.5% share to Coinbase. That was incorrect: those metrics refer to Circle's own platform. Coinbase's 22 billion dollar average is separately reported by Coinbase for Q3.

headline_findings.claim: Circle launched Arc public mainnet on September 16, 2026. SBI Group is in the founding-validator cohort with phased rollout; Coinbase, Binance and Kraken are listed as exchange-access participants, not validators. Arc uses USDC for gas.
limits: Circle describes a phased validator rollout; this does not prove SBI was already actively validating at the launch timestamp.
JPYC appears in the local-stablecoin list active or onboarding to StableFX. SBI's JPYSC is a distinct trust-type yen stablecoin; JPYSC deployment on Arc/StableFX is not established.
Circle states Arc is operated by a permissioned validator set and had not been reviewed or approved by NYDFS or another regulatory authority at launch.

headline_findings.claim: XRP Radar reports 22.38 billion XRP in 701 publicly attributed wallets across 24 exchanges as of November 2, 2026; this is a floor, not tradable float.
limits: Mostly pooled customer deposits and cold storage, plus some exchange-controlled reserves; some exchange wallets are unlabeled or omitted.
Wallet balances do not establish available order-book liquidity, customer ownership, or intent to sell.

headline_findings.claim: XRP Radar reports 417.8 million XRP across tracked DeFi/AMM, bridge and wrapped-XRP categories, including 150.9 million cbXRP and 19.4 million wXRP.
limits: Protocol categories may represent different custody/bridging states; do not automatically treat every unit as freely liquid or as incremental demand.
Coinbase proof-of-reserves and the cbXRP supply read should be reconciled at a common timestamp before computing a precise reserve ratio.

headline_findings.claim: XRP Radar reports 14,875,541 XRPL x402 agent transactions, 190 agents, 183 merchants and 5,791 endpoints, with cumulative settlement of 7,022 XRP plus 40,389 RLUSD.
limits: Derived USD value uses the page's approximately 1.25 dollar XRP mark and a 1 dollar RLUSD assumption; this is an approximate conversion, not historical cash-flow accounting.

The source operator says settlements are native XRPL Payments tagged with SourceTag 804681468 and spot-checks recent transactions against rippled. Only a sample is independently checked by the publisher; the complete 14.9 million transaction history was not independently reprocessed in this run.
Transaction count is not capital deployed, XRP spot demand, revenue, or unique payer count.

headline_findings.claim: XRP Radar reports 4.33 billion dollars of tracked XRPL tokenized RWA value, comprising approximately 276 million dollars of transferable on-chain assets and 4.06 billion dollars of platform-locked registry notional.
limits: The 4.06 billion registry component is not freely transferable investor float and must not be described as deployed or liquid capital.
Per-asset source dates range from July 3 through October 23, 2026.

headline_findings.claim: XRP Radar reports 1 billion XRP released from Ripple-owned escrow on November 1, 2026, 700 million re-escrowed in three new escrow objects later that day, and approximately 300 million net leaving escrow. The next scheduled unlock is 1 billion XRP on December 1, 2026.
limits: Escrow release is not proof of sale, exchange deposit, or circulating market supply increase of the same amount.
The source describes pinned-ledger rippled reads; independent raw-node reproduction was not performed in this run.

headline_findings.claim: XRP Insights reports 1,196,600,186 XRP held by six spot funds plus BITW on October 30, and net weekly flow of +3,390,356 XRP for October 26-30.
limits: Flows are derived from issuer-reported daily holdings changes; exact execution venue, in-kind creation/redemption and market-maker inventory effects are not disclosed.

Another tracker reports October 30 net outflow of approximately 496,500 dollars while XRP Insights reports approximately -49,932 XRP (about -62,400 dollars). The daily discrepancy is unresolved; exclude that daily observation from predictive features until issuer-level reconciliation.

capital_flow_reconciliation.rule: Separate collateral posting, borrowing, token wrapping, stablecoin settlement, reserve backing, ETF holdings changes, escrow releases and actual spot purchases.
distinctions: XRP posted as collateral is not a new XRP purchase.
cbXRP supply growth is not automatically spot buying; it may reflect wrapping/custody movement of existing XRP.
USDC borrowed against XRP is debt/liquidity, not a new XRP capital inflow.
Liquidations can create forced XRP sales even when collateral onboarding initially reduces voluntary selling.
Coinbase's 22B average USDC product balance is not XRP demand.
Circle's payments to Coinbase are Circle distribution expenses, not an additional Coinbase revenue line to add to Coinbase stablecoin revenue.
x402 transaction counts are not equivalent to dollar settlement value or capital deployed.
Ripple escrow releases are not automatically market sales.
RWA registry notional is not freely transferable tokenized capital.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coinbase XRP collateral and loan products reduce voluntary spot selling by allowing holders to access USDC or margin while retaining XRP exposure.
supporting_evidence: Coinbase Global Exchange accepts XRP cross collateral.
Coinbase consumer product supports up to 100,000 USDC against XRP through Morpho.
cbXRP supply is reported at approximately 150.9M XRP.
disconfirming_or_counterevidence: No aggregate XRP loan/collateral balances or product adoption counts disclosed.
Loan proceeds are debt, not new XRP buying.
The consumer loan's XRP LTV and liquidation threshold are materially more conservative than BTC/ETH.
measurable_tests: Daily cbXRP mint/burn and reserve changes.
Morpho XRP collateral, borrow, liquidation and health-factor time series.
Coinbase Global Exchange XRP collateral multiplier, ADQ cap and liquidation flows.
Matched Coinbase wallet flows and XRP order-book depth.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coinbase's USDC economics and Arc expansion make Coinbase/Circle stablecoin rails more strategically important than XRP as a payment bridge on some corridors.
supporting_evidence: Coinbase average USDC held reached 22B in Q3.
Coinbase says it captured about 50% of USDC economics over the prior year.
Arc uses USDC for gas and integrates StableFX and Circle Payments Network.
SBI Group is in Arc's founding-validator cohort.
disconfirming_or_counterevidence: Ripple has said it will use USDC alongside RLUSD in Ripple Payments.
No measured migration of payment routes or liquidity away from XRPL.
SBI's JPYSC is not verified on Arc; JPYC is the StableFX-listed Japanese stablecoin.
measurable_tests: Corridor-level settlement volumes and fees by chain/asset.
USDC and RLUSD supply/velocity by chain.
StableFX route volumes, Arc validator activation and JPYSC interoperability.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Ripple Prime's Coinbase Derivatives access expands institutional XRP hedging and risk transfer, improving market access without necessarily creating spot demand.
supporting_evidence: Official Ripple/Nodal announcement grants Ripple Prime clients access to Coinbase Derivatives' full suite including XRP contracts.
Coinbase reports strong derivatives market-share and volume growth.
disconfirming_or_counterevidence: No Ripple Prime XRP positions, client counts, contract volumes or open interest attributable to the relationship disclosed.
Derivatives exposure can hedge or short spot XRP rather than create net demand.
measurable_tests: Venue-level XRP contract volume/open interest, basis, funding and block-trade data.
Publicly disclosed Ripple Prime product/clearing volume updates.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: XRPL agentic payments demonstrate adoption but currently contribute negligible XRP capital demand relative to institutional collateral and custody balances.
supporting_evidence: XRP Radar reports approximately 14.9M x402 transactions but only 7,022 XRP and 40,389 RLUSD settled all-time; derived total value is about 49.2K dollars at the captured mark.
disconfirming_or_counterevidence: Transaction value may be intentionally sub-cent; low dollar value does not negate utility or future growth.
Full facilitator history has not been independently replayed.
measurable_tests: Validated-ledger replay of all SourceTag 804681468 payments.
Daily value, median/mean payment, XRP/RLUSD mix, active payers and repeat payer concentration.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: SBI is diversifying across Ripple/XRPL and Circle/Arc rather than selecting one exclusive network.
supporting_evidence: SBI's Ripple relationships coexist with its Circle USDC distribution and Arc founding-validator cohort.
SBI's own Arc statement references both USDC and JPYSC.
disconfirming_or_counterevidence: No internal allocation, live validator activity, JPYSC Arc deployment or route-level volumes disclosed.
measurable_tests: SBI filings, validator telemetry, JPYSC chain deployment, SBI VC Trade wallet/flow data, Ripple corridor usage.

data_quality_corrections: Correct prior Circle Q2 2026 filing interpretation: 12.442B USDC on platform and 19.5% daily weighted-average share are Circle's own platform metrics, not Coinbase's.
Use Coinbase's separate Q3 2026 disclosure of 22B average USDC held in Coinbase products; it is an average, not an end-of-quarter balance.
Do not add Circle distribution expenses paid to Coinbase to Coinbase stablecoin revenue; they are different sides of the commercial arrangement and may overlap economically.
Do not apply the generic 86% BTC/ETH Morpho liquidation figure to XRP. The Block reports 49% maximum LTV and 62.5% liquidation threshold for XRP/DOGE/ADA/LTC.
Do not treat XRP Radar's 22.38B exchange wallet total as tradable float.
Do not treat 4.33B RWA notional as freely transferable capital; only 276M is classified as distributed on-chain float.
Do not treat x402 transaction count as material capital inflow; current reported all-time settlement value is approximately 49.2K dollars at the captured mark.
Do not treat escrow unlock/release as sale or spot supply without tracing subsequent transactions.
Do not treat the Coinbase/Morpho collateral wrapper mapping as fully verified until loan-route transactions are traced.

forecast_status.reason: No synchronized, immutable point-in-time dataset or resolved out-of-sample evaluation supports a directional XRP forecast. No calibrated predictive skill is established.
